jamie (eng-release): RC 2023.12.1 created from candidate/feature-abc. Build: 20231201-57. Release notes live at https://go/release/2023.12.1 — tagging for promo window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please ACK QA + SRE signoff.

nina (sre): ACKing. Can we confirm canary plan and rollback trigger thresholds?

sam (product): QA gave the thumbs up earlier, test matrix green. I updated release notes with the known caveats.

leo (eng): Artifact hash: sha256:6b1f9e7d4c3a2b8f9e0a1c3d5e6f7a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5. Pin this for the promo.

deploy-bot: Build 20231201-57 verified. Smoke tests: PASS. Integration tests: PASS. Canaries available: 200 rps capacity.

jamie (eng-release): Proposed rollout: canary 5% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> 100% ramp, with automatic abort on error rate >0.5% or latency p95 > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

nina (sre): +1 on the guardrails. Also recommend CPU threshold: node avg CPU < 70% during ramp. If CPU>80% for 2m, throttle ramp and alert oncall.

sam (product): Noted. Add to release notes: fallback behavior and user visible changes.

leo (eng): Confirming rollback target: previous pinned prod = v2023.11.9 (sha256:4f3e2d1c...). If we hit the error threshold, deploy-bot should auto-rollback to that pinned hash.

jamie (eng-release): I'll pin and start preflight checks now. Command I ran:
```
/deploy preflight --rc=2023.12.1 --artifact=sha256:6b1f9e7d... --smoke --canary-size=5%
```

deploy-bot: Preflight started. Running async canary tests. Expected duration ~6m.

deploy-bot: Preflight complete. Canary smoke ok. No regressions detected in health checks.

jamie (eng-release): Scheduling promo for 02:05 UTC to give a 5m buffer after window opens. Who's oncall?

nina (sre): I'm oncall at that time. I'll watch the ramp and will trigger rollback manually if guardrails trip and auto-rollback doesn't complete.

sam (product): I'm available for 02:00-03:00 for any customer-facing comms if needed.

leo (eng): I'll standby for fast patch if rollback reveals a hotfix path.

deploy-bot: Pinning prod to sha256:6b1f9e7d4c3a2b8f9e0a1c3d5e6f7a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5 (rc-2023.12.1).

jamie (eng-release): Promo command queued. Triggering in 10m. Final sanity check: any objections?

nina (sre): None from me.

sam (product): All good.

jamie (eng-release): Starting promo now.

deploy-bot: Promo started. Canary at 5%. Monitoring metrics: errors 0.02%, p95 latency 320ms, CPU avg 42%.

(15m later)
deploy-bot: Canary steady. Increasing to 50%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% complete. Monitoring: errors 0.04%, p95 360ms, CPU 46%.

jamie (eng-release): Proceeding to 100% in 10m if metrics stable.

nina (sre): Watchdog enabled. Will abort if errors exceed 0.5% or CPU >80% for sustained 2m.

(5m later)
deploy-bot: Final ramp to 100% complete. All guardrails within thresholds. Promo finished — production serving rc-2023.12.1.

sam (product): Notifying customers and publishing release notes update.

leo (eng): Updating internal pins and tagging the deployment in the changelog.

jamie (eng-release): Great work team. Postmortem/training notes to follow if any unexpected issues crop up. Closing thread. :tada:
